title: ltr-wake labels paper packages 'real-money/prop' and fires repeatedly on ib_paper packages that have no apply path
note: FOUND 2026-11-02 00:20-02:15Z (manager): ltr-wake comments on #17895 headline 'newly due on real-money/prop packages' for bybit_1 / ib_paper (paper) packages. ib_paper MGC pkg-d76f1b15 woke 3x in 2h (giveback, momentum_flip) with account_bounds 'no apply path for this exchange yet (LTR-9)', so every review there is no_action. Fix: label the account class correctly in the wake headline, and coalesce wakes for a package reviewed inside its cooldown when its apply path is none. No new gate: wakes still fire, the headline and cooldown change. Pick up after the 2026-11-04 reset. 2026-11-06 BACKLOG-DRAIN-20261106: RE-DATED to 2026-11-09. Not built; build lane. DAILY REVIEW 2026-11-15 (manager), second symptom of the same class, filed here; owner moved to AM-OPS because the AM-TRADING lane is archived. attention_watch 'live_review_due_stale' is BREACHED by 6 due events unreviewed for more than 120 min, the oldest mhg_pullback_1d on ib_paper (demo). Paper and demo events are NEVER dispatched: src/runtime/wake_toggles.py 'ltr_paper' default False, so wakes go only to real-money/prop. The alarm counts them anyway (scripts/ops/attention_watch.py _lr_due_clause counts every due event in live_review_due()), so it breaches as noise and would hide a real stale real-money/prop review. FIX (Tier 1, no new gate): _lr_due_clause counts only events whose wake class toggle is on (wake_toggles classify by account_class; the same classes live_review_wake_post fires), and states the excluded count in the detail ('N paper/demo due excluded: wake toggle off'). If the toggle is turned on, they count again automatically. Test: one paper and one real-money stale event; only the real-money one breaches.
